lines.text: Come back here, you furry little thief!
Detective Marcus chased a cat burglar into a pyramid. Then, the door slammed shut.
Ooh, a visitor! My first one in three thousand years!
Three doors. One way out. The other two... not so much.
Door one. A fire that burns for one thousand years.
Door two. Lions that have not eaten in three years.
Door three. A flood that arrives in three thousand years.
Easy! Those lions starved ages ago. I pick door two!
Careful, detective. I carved these signs on my very first day. Three thousand years ago.
Oh, and my kitties are mummies too. They can't starve. They just get hungrier!
Fire, lions, or flood. Only one door is safe. Which door would you choose?
